_note: Prices are published list prices gathered 2026-11-22 (see docs/phase0/models-compute.md for every source link). Items marked assumption are not measured and are meant to be changed.

batch_discount.source: Batch API 50% off input and output; stacks with caching (same page)

hosted_open_model_per_mtok.label: DeepInfra Qwen3.5-9B (closest listed size to our 4B model)

T4 (AWS g4dn.xlarge).note: On-demand, the page's default view (US East, Linux), read 2026-11-23. Same GPU as Kaggle's T4, where throughput was measured.

max_utilization.why: headroom for traffic peaks; a GPU run near 100% busy queues requests

self_host.throughput_note: Throughput is measured on a Kaggle T4 with plain Hugging Face generate (batch 16). An L4 is a newer, faster card, so pricing T4 throughput at L4 rates overstates self-hosting cost. A serving engine like vLLM would raise throughput further. Both make the self-host numbers conservative.

engineering.why: Placeholder for one engineer building the serving path and retraining monthly. Not measured; the sensitivity table shows how the answer moves when this changes.
